_comment: Historical four-visit regression manifest, not the expanded six-participant inventory. Paths are relative to --data-root (default ../data-physio; raw logs are never committed). dev/regression are software-development roles, not independent validation cohorts. Expected verdicts describe stored historical outputs; input equivalence to the current complete archive has not been established by hash. Participants are labelled S01/S02; pre/post are repeated visits.

S01_pre.note: Historical output: PPG clipping 4.5%, respiratory footer reported missing. Current complete respiratory archive has clock endpoints; historical input provenance unresolved.

S01_post.note: Pulse record is flat at 2048; physiological use is invalid. Historical output reported missing respiratory footer; current complete respiratory archive has clock endpoints. Sensor disconnection is not independently established.
